edits.before: Late-game Cass is a hyper-carry: ground their divers, petrify their engage, and machine-gun whoever is closest.
edits.after: Fate Sealed pulls you out of position from 1000 range — a fed Yone flanks past the frontline and you are the target.

edits.before: Yone wins by landing Soul Unbound, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Yone wins by shielding through your poke with Spirit Cleave, then chaining Mortal Steel into Fate Sealed.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your R Petrifying Gaze like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 and 10s at rank 5 — survive the spirit and punish the body it snaps back to. - Spirit Cleave shields him every 14s, so force it out first. - Mortal Steel is 4s; Fate Sealed is 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Carry by DPS — no mid matches your damage-per-second from two items; your job is staying alive long enough to prove it.
edits.after: Carry by anti-shield tempo: Spirit Cleave comes back every 14s, so force it out and burst the window while it is gone.

edits.before: Ahead, suffocate: poison every last-hit, zone Yone off the wave with fang threat, and call your jungler — your W makes every gank a guaranteed kill.
edits.after: Ahead, suffocate: poison every last-hit, deny him the minions he stacks Mortal Steel on, and call your jungler — Miasma grounds his dash out.

edits.before: Kite backward with Q's movement-speed slow
edits.after: Kite backward on Q's movement-speed buff

edits.before: His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Noxious Blast speeds you up when it hits a champion, and her passive amplifies it — poison, then walk out of his reach.

edits.before: Q the last-hit window, E-E-E while the poison ticks, and walk back as it fades — three fangs and out, repeat until Yone is executable.
edits.after: Miasma grounds: the third-stack Mortal Steel dash stops dead in it, and a Yone standing in your poison has to walk the trade out.

edits.before: Yone whiffs Soul Unbound and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing you — turn into his dash.

edits.before: That is Yone’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Miasma is the only thing stopping his dash chain — spend it early and he arrives free.

edits.before: Spamming unpoisoned fangs at full mana cost, or holding W so long the dash you were saving it for already happened.
edits.after: A 120-second ultimate spent on his first dash leaves you nothing for the knockup that actually kills you.

edits.before: Track Yone’s Soul Unbound: His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Soul Unbound (22s at rank 1): his spirit repeats its damage on return, so survive the window and burst the body it snaps back to.

edits.before: Once you hit rank 2 Q you start chunking his approach with Noxious Blast poke before he can close with Mounting Tempest, and Miasma zones his dash-in so he eats grounded damage over time instead of a clean trade.
edits.after: Once you hit rank 2 Q you chunk his approach with Noxious Blast before he can stack Mortal Steel to its dash, and Miasma grounds that third cast so he eats poison over time instead of getting a clean trade.

edits.before: Rylai's or Liandry's on you means your poke DoTs plus slow make it nearly impossible for him to stick Mounting Tempest through without eating a full rotation first.
edits.after: Rylai's or Liandry's means your DoT and slow make it near-impossible for him to stick Mortal Steel on you without eating a full rotation and burning his 14s shield first.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are close to even — his Q3 knockup threatens a short trade window but he can't commit hard without minion wave support, and your ranged poke keeps him from just walking up freely. By level 3 you have full access to Noxious Blast and Twin Fang, and the moment he tries to dash in through minions to stack Mounting Tempest you can already be chunking his HP from range, forcing him to either eat poke or delay his combo.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are close to even — his third Mortal Steel knocks up, but he cannot commit without wave support, and your ranged poke keeps him from walking up freely. By level 3 you have Noxious Blast and Twin Fang, and the moment he steps through minions to stack Mortal Steel you are already chunking him from 850, forcing him to eat poke or delay the combo. Spirit Cleave shields him every 14 seconds, so make him spend it on the wave.

edits.before: Bait his Mounting Tempest engage into your ground zone, then E-W-E burst
edits.after: Bait his Mortal Steel dash into your ground zone, then Q-E-E burst

notes: 'Mounting Tempest' is a fabricated name for Yone's Q (Mortal Steel) and appeared in four content fields — all four fixed. LEVEL CHART: full phases[2,3,4].side read Skill and phases[6].side read Skill, while content win[2,3,4] read Cassiopeia and win[6] read Yone, matching packet.levelChart; I moved the full sides to the content values. No paired win[N] edit exists because the content layer already holds the target values on disk. phases[6].why was the generic Cassiopeia hyper-carry template and would have contradicted the new 'Yone' side, so it was rewritten in the same proposal. dosFull[1].d claims Miasma's grounding stops the Mortal Steel dash — that rests on the kit's dash flag plus Miasma's 'Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities' text. I deliberately did NOT extend the same claim to Fate Sealed anywhere on the page: the kit flags it dash, but a targeted blink behind a champion may not obey grounding and the kit files carry no eligibility data, so it stays unasserted.
